properties.convert_cat_cols_to_int:
SELECT 
	id, 
	address_state, 
	emp_length, 
	emp_title, 
	grade,
    CASE home_ownership
        WHEN 'RENT' THEN 0
        WHEN 'MORTGAGE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'OWN' THEN 2
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 3
        WHEN 'NONE' THEN 4
        ELSE -1
    END AS home_ownership,
    member_id,
	issue_date,
	last_credit_pull_date,
	last_payment_date,
	next_payment_date,
    CASE purpose
        WHEN 'car' THEN 0
        WHEN 'credit card' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Debt consolidation' THEN 2
        WHEN 'educational' THEN 3
        WHEN 'home improvement' THEN 4
        WHEN 'house' THEN 5
        WHEN 'major purchase' THEN 6
        WHEN 'medical' THEN 7
        WHEN 'moving' THEN 8
        WHEN 'other' THEN 9
        WHEN 'renewable_energy' THEN 10
        WHEN 'small business' THEN 11
        WHEN 'vacation' THEN 12
        WHEN 'wedding' THEN 13
        ELSE -1
    END AS purpose,
    sub_grade,
    CASE term
        WHEN ' 60 months' THEN 1
        WHEN ' 36 months' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS term,
    CASE verification_status
        WHEN 'Source Verified' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Verified' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Not Verified' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS verification_status,
    annual_income, 
	dti, 
	installment, 
	int_rate, 
	loan_amount, 
	total_acc, 
	total_payment,
    CASE loan_status
        WHEN 'Fully Paid' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Current' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Charged Off' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS loan_status
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.extract date parts:
SELECT 
    id,
    address_state,
    emp_length,
    emp_title,
    grade,
    home_ownership,
    issue_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_month_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(issue_date AS DATE)) AS issue_date_week_of_year,
    last_credit_pull_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_date_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_month_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_date_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(last_credit_pull_date AS DATE)) AS last_credit_pull_date_week_of_year,
    last_payment_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_month_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(last_payment_date AS DATE)) AS last_payment_date_week_of_year,
    loan_status,
    next_payment_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_month_of_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(next_payment_date AS DATE)) AS next_payment_date_week_of_year,
    member_id,
    purpose,
    sub_grade,
    term,
    verification_status,
    annual_income,
    dti,
    installment,
    int_rate,
    loan_amount,
    total_acc,
    total_payment
FROM FLOWFILE
